answer: Duplicating identities means acquiring duplicate tokens, and each token costs a bonded stake slashed on proof of shared seed. At each dawn, every agent must submit a cipher proving knowledge of a secret seeded from a cedar-wood token physically issued once per operator. Attackers must therefore burn real capital per fake identity, making mass sybil creation economically irrational while honest agents pay only one token. In practice, once0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
